title: FIPS 140-3 Cryptographic Call-Site Inventory Entry
description: Schema for a single cataloged cryptographic call site or classification row produced by WO-005 (Catalog crypto call sites in keysutil policy.go). The inventory file is a JSON/YAML array of objects conforming to this schema. Consumed by the aggregation story (WO-019) that builds the composite FIPS evidence inventory.

file.description: Repository-relative path to the source file containing the call site, e.g. sdk/helper/keysutil/policy.go

line.description: 1-based line number in `file` where the call site, constant, or map entry is defined

function.description: Enclosing Go function, method, or package-level declaration (const block, var block, map literal) containing the call site

algorithm.description: Cryptographic algorithm or primitive exercised at this call site (e.g. AES-256-GCM, Ed25519, RSA-PSS, HKDF-SHA256)

key_type.description: Vault keysutil.KeyType constant name this entry corresponds to, or 'N/A' / 'multiple' for entries not tied to exactly one KeyType (hash helpers, KDF modes, cross-reference rows)

library.description: Go import path or module providing the implementation (e.g. crypto/aes, golang.org/x/crypto/chacha20poly1305, github.com/tink-crypto/tink-go/v2/kwp/subtle)

library_version.description: Pinned version of the library as declared in the relevant go.mod (or 'stdlib (go X.Y.Z)' for Go standard library packages, or 'internal (same module)' for in-repo helper packages)

security_relevant.description: True if the operation protects data confidentiality, integrity, or authenticity (encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify, MAC, KDF, key generation/wrap). False for non-cryptographic helpers (test-only code, content-addressing).

fips_approved.description: True if the algorithm, as used, is Approved per NIST SP 800-140C / FIPS 186-5 / SP 800-38D / FIPS 198-1 / FIPS 204 / FIPS 205, subject to the notes field for conditional cases (e.g. delegated-to-KMS, build-tag dependent).

enterprise_only.description: True if this KeyType or code path is gated by keysutil.KeyType.IsEnterpriseOnly() and unavailable in the Community Edition build; such entries are out of scope for CE remediation per the WO-005 constraints.

phase2_action.description: The remediation action Phase 2 (Approved-Algorithm Configuration) should take for this call site.

notes.description: Optional free-text context: wire-format impact, boundary exclusions, conditional FIPS status, or references to related call sites.
